title: Friends: Seishun no Kagayaki
overview:
Friends: Seishun no Kagayaki is a romance adventure about meeting old friends again. You head out to a resort to see your former high school classmates, above all your old teammates from the tennis club. Move around the resort and the surrounding countryside on a map, talk with your friends in fully voiced scenes and choose how to spend your time. Your choices decide where the story goes: rekindle a first love, find a new romance, or play matchmaker and help your friends get together. The second disc is a special disc.

- Two discs: game disc and special disc
- Extended RAM Cartridge (1MB or 4MB) support for faster loading
- Single player
- Memory backup save
